<!-- pr-reviewer: cf0789c35c8916c5501a748afc1725b91a5ce849 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** 

## What looks good
- The drop queues `CommandKind::ImportFile(path)` (file_drop.rs `take_drop`), the same import the Model dialog ends in. There is no second import path, and the test checks that one undo removes the model.
- `classify` refuses zero files, several files, an unsupported extension and a path that is not a file. Each message names the file and the reason. A refusal goes through `State::refuse_drop` (status line and a diagnostic), and the document is not touched.
- A corrupt file reaches the importer, which says "import refused". A test pins that the project is unchanged.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in the new non-test code. The tests use `expect`, which is allowed.
- The ui layer does not call sys_* or raw Flecs. The new code is view state plus a queued command.
- No snapshot PNG changed. The structural twin `the_drop_hint_shows_only_while_a_file_hovers` is added. The decision file is present and the body has `Changelog:`, `Effort:` and `Fixes`.
- `file_drop.rs` is 90 lines and `tests/file_drop.rs` is 95. The diff touches only `crates/ui/` and one `docs/decisions/` file.

## Results merged with main
On the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43521870071 (success; PR head cf0789c trial-merged with main 632365b).
- Quick gate: ui suites ok (58s), 0 failed.
- Clippy: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
- Nothing was built locally.

Not exercised: the drop was not tried in the running app (no GUI launch). The tests feed egui's raw dropped and hovered file input. Windows-only readings do not apply, because the diff has no `cfg(windows)` or `cfg(target_os)` line. The browser path is out of scope (issue 1431).

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
1. `crates/ui/src/state.rs:2088-2095`: `refuse_drop` was inserted between the doc comment of `refuse` ("Record a refusal: status strip for everyone...") and `fn refuse`. That doc comment now merges into `refuse_drop`'s, and `refuse` loses it. Move `refuse_drop` above that doc comment.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs` (1011 lines) and `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (4346 lines) were already over ~400 lines before this PR. The PR adds 4 and 6 lines, so it does not make them noticeably worse. It is flagged, not blocking.
3. A screenshot of the hint is owed, as the body says. The AGENTS.md note on UI PRs asks for before/after screenshots in the description before merge.
4. `take_drop` reads `raw.dropped_files` every frame. That is fine, because egui clears it each frame. Two drops in different frames import twice, which is the expected behaviour.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
